LETTERS = ascii_lowercase

def task_func(string):

    match = LETTERS_PATTERN.match(string)
    prefix = match.group(1) if match else string.rsplit("-", 1)[0] if "-" in string else string

    counts = Counter(ch for ch in prefix if ch in LETTERS)
